title: 문과 엘리베이터: 미세요, 당기세요, 층
objective: You can read and say 미세요, 당기세요, 열림, 닫힘 and floor numbers like 지하 2층.
summary: Read the Korean signs and buttons on doors and in elevators.

task.title: Read the signs
task.line: Read each sign or button out loud first, then answer.

words.meaning: floor (of a building); floors use Sino-Korean numbers: 1층 = 일 층, 2층 = 이 층, 6층 = 육 층, 7층 = 칠 층
words.exampleMeaning: Which floor are you going to?
The parking lot is on B1.

letters.as: PUSH. ㅁ sounds like the m in 'me'.
PULL. Final ㅇ sounds like the ng in 'sing'.
CLOSE button. Final ㄷ + ㅎ becomes ㅌ, and ㅌ before ㅣ becomes ㅊ, so 닫히 sounds like [다치] ('ch').

exercises: Choose the real sound: ① 닫힘 → [다딤 / 다침] ② 열림 → [열림 / 연님] ③ 지하 2층 → [지하 이층 / 지하 둘층]
Which elevator button do you press? Write 열림 or 닫힘: ① 친구가 엘리베이터 앞에 와요. ② 사람이 안 와요. 지금 가요.
Look at the sign on the door. Do you push or pull? Write Push or Pull: ① 당기세요 ② 미세요
Write how you say the elevator button in Korean: ① B2 ② 7
Answer in Korean: ① 몇 층 가세요? (You are going to floor 6.) ② 이 문 밀어요? (The sign on the door says 당기세요.)
answers: ① 지하 이 층 (지하 2층) ② 칠 층 (7층)
① 육 층이요. (6층이요. / 6층 가요.) ② 아니요, 당기세요. (아니요, 당겨요.)
